Major divergence across large stocks: GOOGL RECOVERY (1W: +1.77% | 1M: -18.23%), while AAPL is in CORRECTION (1W: -0.66% | 1M: +0.57%); watch for trend breaks rather than treating short-term moves as core signals.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -8.80% | 1M: -19.02%), META BELOW TREND (1W: -0.79% | 1M: -15.36%), and MSFT ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.67% | 1M: +1.53%); AAPL is in CORRECTION (1W: -0.66% | 1M: +0.57%) and GOOGL in RECOVERY (1W: +1.77% | 1M: -18.23%).

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are nearly flat for the week (+0.06%) but positive over the month (+2.83%) across 20 stocks; member-positive breadth was not provided. V ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.19% | 1M: +12.68%) and MA ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.30% | 1M: +13.73%), while JPM is in CORRECTION (1W: -0.76% | 1M: +0.93%).

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare is modestly positive for the week (+0.14%) and stronger over the month (+9.15%) across 17 stocks; member-positive breadth was not provided. SYK ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.65% | 1M: +17.66%) and JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.11% | 1M: +7.70%), while LLY is in CORRECTION (1W: -4.48% | 1M: +15.77%).

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective exposure to relative-strength names such as SYK ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.65% | 1M: +17.66%) and V ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.19% | 1M: +12.68%); reduce exposure to persistent Technology and Energy weakness. Style mixed / no clear leadership: sector breadth does not confirm a Growth- or Value-led call.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: TTWO ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +2.63%) and GE ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.10% | 1M: +5.77%) if momentum holds; LLY is a conditional watch after revenue guidance, but remains in CORRECTION (1W: -4.48% | 1M: +15.77%). BEARISH: LRCX BELOW TREND (1W: -16.17% | 1M: -37.48%) and TSLA BELOW TREND (1W: -10.40% | 1M: -4.47%) if selling pressure persists.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Consumer Discretionary, up 2.49% for 1W and 8.06% for 1M, and Communication, up 3.81% and 0.56%; constituent-positive counts were not supplied. BEARISH: Technology (-6.73% 1W, -13.12% 1M) and Energy (-11.93%, -7.00%) remain the clearest areas of weakness.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Price levels were not supplied, so specific support and resistance cannot be stated. Monitor whether NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -8.80% | 1M: -19.02%) stabilizes and whether GOOGL RECOVERY (1W: +1.77% | 1M: -18.23%) follows through; broad divergence argues for confirmation before treating rebounds as trend changes.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
LRCX (+90): $25 billion share repurchase authorization; BELOW TREND (1W: -16.17% | 1M: -37.48%), sentiment-price divergence. LLY (+75): 2026 revenue forecast raised; CORRECTION (1W: -4.48% | 1M: +15.77%), near-term price action diverges from the catalyst. TTWO (+55): strong preorder report; ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +2.63%), sentiment confirmed; GE (+55): major China aerospace deals; ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.10% | 1M: +5.77%), sentiment confirmed.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
TSLA (-35): Cybertruck production reportedly set to end in 2027; BELOW TREND (1W: -10.40% | 1M: -4.47%), sentiment confirmed. MMM (-45): dividend cut after 64 years of increases; ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.20% | 1M: +13.19%), price action diverges from negative news; TTWO (-45): price-target reduction, but ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +2.63%), also divergent.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF is the supplied regime, with Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive and broad leadership across four sectors in the Top 5; style is mixed. SYK ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.65% | 1M: +17.66%) and AMZN ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.88% | 1M: +2.06%) show relative strength. Major cross-timeframe divergence and LRCX’s strongly positive news score despite sharp price weakness warrant caution and confirmation.
